Location: Mount Vernon NSW 2178

About the Business:
IN2 FONES PTY LTD is a dynamic and expanding telecommunications retail business that operates multiple Vodafone-branded stores and customer service operations across New South Wales. With a recent growth to approximately 10 stores, the company specialises in delivering high-quality mobile phones, tablets, smart watches, service plans, accessories, and repair services to a diverse customer base. Known for its strong focus on customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and market competitiveness, IN2 FONES fosters a supportive and performance-driven workplace culture that values teamwork, professional development, and innovation in the fast-paced retail telecom sector.
About the Position:
The Retail Manager plays a pivotal leadership role in overseeing the day-to-day operations of three telecommunications retail stores within IN2 FONES PTY LTD. This position is responsible for driving sales, profitability, and operational efficiency while implementing strategic initiatives to enhance market presence and customer experience. The role is essential for supporting the company’s continued expansion and achieving business objectives in a competitive retail environment.
Key Responsibilities:
Direct and control the day-to-day operations of three telecommunications retail stores to ensure the achievement of sales, profitability and operational objectives.
Determine product mix, pricing strategies and stock levels for mobile phones, tablets, smart watches, telecommunications service plans, accessories and repair services in accordance with market demand and business objectives.
Develop and implement purchasing, sales and marketing strategies, including promotional campaigns and bundled product offers, to increase revenue and strengthen market competitiveness.
Manage procurement, inventory planning, stock control, stock reconciliation and loss prevention across all retail locations to ensure product availability and minimise inventory shrinkage.
Analyse sales reports, financial results and key performance indicators (KPIs) to identify business trends, improve operational efficiency and maximise profitability.
Prepare and manage store budgets, monitor operating expenses and implement cost-control measures to achieve financial performance targets.
Recruit, supervise, train, roster and manage the performance of retail staff across all store locations to ensure operational efficiency and achievement of business objectives.
Oversee visual merchandising, product displays and promotional activities to maximise product visibility, sales performance and brand consistency.
Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety legislation, company policies, retail procedures and all relevant regulatory requirements.
Liaise with senior management to implement business strategies, improve operational processes and support the continued commercial growth of the business.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Diploma level qualification (or equivalent).
Minimum 1 year of relevant experience.
Proven leadership and team management skills with the ability to recruit, train, motivate and develop retail staff.
Strong commercial acumen, including experience in sales target achievement, inventory management, budgeting, and profit optimisation.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with a customer-focused mindset and ability to build positive relationships.
Analytical skills to interpret sales data, KPIs, and financial reports to drive informed decision-making.
Knowledge of retail operations in telecommunications or a similar fast-paced consumer goods environment.
Commitment to compliance, workplace health and safety, and high ethical standards.

To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.

About the Business
San Antonio Group Pty Ltd is a well-established bakery specialising in the production of traditional baked goods and confectionery products. The company prepares a wide range of fresh breads, pastries, cakes, desserts, and specialty items daily using both traditional and modern techniques. Products are supplied directly to customers through its retail outlet in Kirribilli, with a strong emphasis on ingredient sourcing, quality control, food safety compliance, and customer satisfaction. Renowned for its commitment to consistency, innovation in recipes, and high presentation standards, the business values integrity, teamwork, and excellence in every batch. The workplace culture fosters a supportive, hygienic, and collaborative environment where staff take pride in delivering exceptional baked goods to the local community.
About the Position
The Pastrycook plays a vital role in San Antonio Group Pty Ltd’s daily operations, responsible for preparing and producing a diverse range of high-quality pastries, cakes, and baked goods according to established recipes and standards. This position involves hands-on production from ingredient preparation through to finishing and packaging, ensuring all items meet the bakery’s strict quality, freshness, and presentation requirements. The role is essential to maintaining the business’s reputation for excellence and supporting timely supply to retail customers in a fast-paced bakery environment.
Key Responsibilities
Prepare and produce a wide range of pastries, cakes and other baked goods in accordance with San Antonio Group's established recipes, production methods and quality standards.
Measure, weigh and prepare ingredients, ensuring all raw materials meet required quality and freshness standards.
Mix, laminate, shape and proof doughs and pastry products using both manual techniques and commercial bakery equipment.
Prepare a variety of pastry fillings, creams, icings and decorative finishes for baked products.
Monitor proofing, baking processes and oven temperatures to ensure products are baked consistently and meet quality and presentation standards.
Coordinate the production process, including preparing, baking, cooling, finishing and packaging bakery products to meet daily production schedules.
Decorate cakes, pastries and desserts using glazes, creams, icings and other finishing techniques to achieve high presentation standards.
Operate and maintain commercial bakery equipment, including mixers, dough sheeters, moulders and ovens, ensuring safe and efficient operation.
Maintain a clean, hygienic and organised work area by cleaning equipment, utensils, baking trays and production areas in accordance with food safety and workplace health and safety requirements.
Requirements
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Certificate III in Baking or a related field.
Minimum 1 year of relevant experience as a Pastrycook or in a similar role.
Strong technical skills in pastry production, dough handling, laminating, baking techniques, and cake decoration.
Sound knowledge of food safety and hygiene regulations, with the ability to maintain a clean and safe working environment.
Excellent attention to detail, time management skills, and the ability to work efficiently under pressure to meet production schedules.
Good interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively as part of a small team.
Physical fitness and stamina to stand for extended periods and handle manual tasks.

Type: Full-time
Employer: Hilal Meat Products Company Pty Ltd
Location: Echuca VIC 3564
Salary: $80,000 p/a
About the Business:
Hilal Meat Products Company Pty Ltd is a leading Australian meat processing, wholesale and export company specialising in the sourcing, processing, packaging and distribution of premium halal-certified meat products. With operations based in Echuca, VIC, the company supplies a wide range of fresh and frozen beef, lamb, mutton, goat and poultry to domestic wholesalers, retailers, food service providers and international markets. Renowned for its unwavering commitment to quality, food safety and strict halal certification standards, Hilal Meat fosters a collaborative, values-driven workplace culture that prioritises integrity, continuous improvement, employee development and compliance excellence in a fast-paced, modern processing environment.
About the Position:
The Meat Inspector plays a critical role in ensuring the highest standards of product quality, safety and regulatory compliance at Hilal Meat Products Company Pty Ltd. This position involves inspecting animal carcasses, internal organs and processing facilities to identify any quality or health issues, while monitoring hygiene, auditing procedures and verifying adherence to Australian food safety and halal requirements. By safeguarding the integrity of our premium meat products throughout processing, storage and distribution, the Meat Inspector supports the company’s reputation for excellence and contributes directly to consumer trust and successful domestic and export operations.
Key Responsibilities:
Inspecting animal carcasses, internal organs and meat products to identify quality issues, diseases or impurities and ensure compliance with required standards.
Auditing and monitoring quality procedures at processing facilities, cold storage and packing areas to maintain hygiene and food safety standards.
Testing samples of meat products for quality, size, purity and adherence to halal certification requirements.
Ensuring required standards of hygiene are observed throughout storage, processing, packaging and transport.
Providing advice on disease eradication, pest and disease identification, and regulations pertaining to grading, packing and loading of products.
Coordinating with production teams on quality assurance matters and contributing to continuous improvement in processing operations.
Maintaining accurate records of inspections and assisting with regulatory compliance and export documentation as needed.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Required qualifications: An AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma in the field (at least three years of relevant experience may substitute for formal qualifications).
Required experience: A minimum of 1 year of experience within the Meat Inspector occupation or a closely related role.
Required technical and interpersonal skills: Strong knowledge of Australian meat industry standards, food safety regulations and halal certification processes; excellent attention to detail and observational skills for conducting thorough inspections; ability to work effectively in a team environment within a processing facility; strong communication skills for providing advice to producers and colleagues; problem-solving abilities in identifying and addressing quality issues; and a commitment to maintaining high hygiene and compliance standards in a dynamic operational setting.

Orange Giraffe Pty Ltd, trading as The Tattersalls Hotel, is looking for experienced Cooks and Chefs to join the team in the heart of Goulburn, NSW. As a well-loved regional pub, The Tattersalls Hotel is a staple in the community, known for its welcoming atmosphere, great food, and exceptional hospitality.

With full-time positions available, the venue offers a competitive salary of $75,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation, negotiable for the right candidate. This is a fantastic opportunity for skilled kitchen professionals who thrive in a fast-paced environment and take pride in delivering quality meals.

Scope of Role:
-  Overseeing daily kitchen operations, including staff delegation, stock rotation, and maintaining accurate records.
-  Preparing and cooking a variety of dishes, either regularly or for special functions and events.
-  Managing production schedules and staff requirements to ensure timely service delivery.
-  Estimating food supply needs, calculating costs for ingredients, and managing orders accordingly.
-  Inspecting supplies, equipment, and work areas to ensure adherence to established quality standards.
-  Analysing recipes and advising prices to menu items based on food, labour, and overhead costs.
-  Collaborating with other team members to plan and develop recipes and menus, taking into account seasonal ingredient availability and projected customer numbers.
-  Demonstrating new cooking techniques and introducing equipment to staff for continual culinary improvement.
-  Ensure all workstations are properly set up, thoroughly cleaned, and efficiently organised, preparing utensils, ovens, and grills for optimal readiness at the start of each shift.
-  Prepare and cook dishes in strict compliance with food safety and health regulations, ensuring the highest quality and hygiene standards are maintained.
-  Assist in onboarding, training, and supervising new team members, providing guidance and fostering a collaborative, efficient work environment.
-  Monitoring and enforcing sanitation practices to ensure compliance with health and safety regulations, including Occupational Health and Safety (WHS) and HACCP.


To be considered for this role, you should:
-  Proven experience as a Cook or Chef in a busy kitchen.
-   Relevant Qualifications – Certificate III & IV in Commercial Cookery.
-  At least 2-3 years of experience in a similar role.
-  Excellent communication skills and a positive, team-focused attitude.
-  Availability to work weekends and split shifts.
-  Willingness to relocate (if not already based in Goulburn).

What’s in It for You?
-  A supportive and down-to-earth team – Work with like-minded professionals in a friendly environment.
-  Career development and growth – Opportunities to progress within the business.
-  A great lifestyle in regional NSW – Be part of a close-knit community while working in a thriving venue.


The Tattersalls Hotel is more than just a workplace—it’s a place where hard work is valued, and local hospitality shines.
If you or someone you know is looking for a great opportunity in Goulburn, apply today!

How to join the team
Please submit an online application to join our diverse, compassionate and dedicated team for a rewarding career. Only successful applicants will be contacted.

Candidates must hold Australian or NZ Citizenship or the capacity to work in Australia permanently. A temporary visa holder may only be employed if no suitable permanent resident or citizen of Australia has been identified for this position following suitable labour market testing.

Grace Morgan 1 Pty Ltd operates as Empowered Early Learning Academy, a reputable provider of high-quality childcare and early education services in Penshurst for children aged 0–5 years. Our purpose-built centre delivers a safe, nurturing, and stimulating environment where every child feels supported, confident, and excited to learn. We pride ourselves on building strong relationships, delivering small group learning, and providing individualised care that supports each child’s unique development. Our values centre on excellence in early childhood education, child safety, and family partnership in a supportive, collaborative workplace culture that empowers staff to grow professionally while making a meaningful difference in young lives.
About the Position:
The Childcare Worker plays a vital role at Empowered Early Learning Academy by providing attentive, high-quality care and educational support to children aged 0–5 years. Working as part of a dedicated team, you will contribute to creating a positive daily experience that promotes children’s social, emotional, physical, and cognitive development while ensuring their safety and wellbeing at all times. This position is essential to maintaining the centre’s reputation for excellence in early childhood education.
Key Responsibilities:
Assisting in the preparation of materials and equipment for children’s education and recreational activities
Managing children’s behaviour and guiding children’s social development
Preparing and conducting activities for children
Entertaining children by reading and playing games

Passion for early childhood development and commitment to child safety and inclusive practices.

result.description:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance. WHOOP, a leader in the wearable tech space, empowers its members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is seeking a Marketing Director, ANZ - to own and execute a fully integrated regional marketing and commercial strategy that drives brand affinity and omni-channel growth. This role serves as the executional owner for the ANZ region, with responsibility for translating global strategies into regionally relevant, culturally resonant programs. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role partners closely with cross-functional teams to align strategy, execution, and performance across the ANZ markets.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

? Own execution and performance of regional omni-channel commercial targets, translating strategic marketing and sales plans into outcomes that deliver both brand and business KPIs.

? Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns that align WHOOP with key cultural moments, regional trends, and community-driven movements, particularly within fitness, wellness, sports, and lifestyle verticals.

? Identify and activate opportunities around mainstream cultural events (e.g., major sporting events, holidays, industry conferences) to deepen brand relevance and drive buzz at local and national levels.

? Lead cross-functional collaboration with Brand, Social, and Partnerships teams to amplify culturally relevant storytelling and ensure cohesive brand messaging across channels.

? Build and maintain strategic relationships with local fitness studios, athletic organizations, wellness influencers, and community leaders to authentically embed WHOOP within target communities.

? Own WHOOP’s grassroots presence in key cities by planning and executing on-the-ground activations, pop-ups, brand experiences, and community events that drive member acquisition, product engagement, and loyalty.

? Own analysis and reporting on campaign impact, community growth, and regional performance to inform future initiatives and improve effectiveness.

? Own regional media strategy and execution in partnership with global leads to ensure effective channel mix and budget allocation.

? Collaborate on regional influencer, creator, and affiliate partnerships to increase brand visibility and conversion.

? Support wholesale expansion and optimise channel performance in coordination with internal sales and trade marketing teams.

? Localise global brand campaigns and creative assets, ensuring cultural nuance, seasonality and alignment with ANZ market dynamics.

? Activate sports and talent marketing strategies within ANZ, identifying opportunities for regional relevance and performance impact.

? Execute global and regional partnerships, product launches, and PR campaigns to drive engagement and cultural connection in the ANZ market.

QUALIFICATIONS

? 8+ years of experience in marketing, including ownership of regional initiatives, preferably within consumer tech, fitness, wellness, or lifestyle brands.

? Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications or a closely related field

? Deep understanding of the ANZ market - media, commercial and competitive landscapes- with demonstrated cultural fluency and insight into consumer behaviour.

? Proven experience across influencer marketing, media planning, and brand partnerships.

? Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret commercial performance data and inform strategic decisions.

? Demonstrated ability to lead complex initiatives through cross-functional collaboration and influence.

? Critical thinker with great problem solving abilities to identify areas of opportunity and improvement on a consistent basis.

? Strong relationship management and communication skills, comfortable holding both partners and internal stakeholders accountable

? Team player but works well independently to balance looking at the larger picture at hand with prioritisation of day to day initiatives.

? Adaptable and thrives in a dynamic and fast moving business

? Is comfortable with constant change, is self motivated and collaborative.

? Demonstrated passion for performance, wellness, and WHOOP’s mission.

LEVEL RESPONSIBILITIES:

? Expertise: Expert at core job responsibilities, seen as an expert/leader by other peers. Solves large, complex problems independently and leads company-wide projects and cross-functional efforts with little guidance

? Collaboration: Establishes clear direction for the team and leads the execution

? Communication: Expresses complicated issues simply to others. Solicits and integrates feedback to improve performance with limited guidance; proactively remedies communication issues

? Influence: Effectively manages cross-functional leads to increase marketing impact for the country. Influences other dept. leaders to increase team impact, while setting and maintaining high standards for team results and output

? Innovation: Consistently looking for new ways to approach and improve work.
result.title: ANZ Marketing Director-

About the Business:
Moorookclub Pty Ltd operates Blanchetown Foodery, a vibrant one-stop destination in the heart of Blanchetown, South Australia, encompassing a cafe, restaurant, and supermarket. The business specialises in delivering a diverse multi-cuisine experience, featuring Italian, Indian, and fast-food options alongside everyday grocery needs. Known for its convenient, high-quality offerings and friendly service in a regional community setting, Blanchetown Foodery values fresh ingredients, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence. It fosters a supportive, team-oriented workplace culture where dedication to food service and community connection are highly regarded.
About the Position:
The Chef plays a central role at Blanchetown Foodery within Moorookclub Pty Ltd, leading the preparation and delivery of high-quality dishes across the cafe and restaurant operations. This position involves creating appealing menus, maintaining exceptional food standards, and contributing to the smooth running of a busy multi-cuisine venue that serves both locals and visitors. The role is essential for upholding the business’s reputation for delicious, diverse food and ensuring an outstanding dining experience that supports the venue’s position as a community favourite.
Key Responsibilities:
Planning menus, estimating food and labour costs, and ordering food supplies.
Monitoring quality of dishes at all stages of preparation and presentation.
Discussing food preparation issues with Managers, Dietitians and kitchen and waiting staff.
Demonstrating techniques and advising on cooking procedures.
Preparing and cooking food.
Explaining and enforcing hygiene regulations.
Selecting and training staff (as required).
Freezing and preserving foods (as required).
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Diploma in a relevant field (such as Commercial Cookery or Hospitality Management).
Minimum 3 years’ work experience as a Chef.
Strong technical skills in multi-cuisine food preparation (including Italian, Indian, and fast food), menu planning, cost control, and presentation.
Excellent knowledge of food safety, hygiene regulations, and quality standards.
Good interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and provide guidance to kitchen staff.
Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced setting while maintaining attention to detail.

Location: Rockingham WA 6168 
Salary: $80,000 p/a
About the Business
Heritage Sphere Pty Ltd T/A Imperial Indian Restaurant is a distinguished dining venue located at the Rockingham Foreshore, specialising in authentic Indian cuisine. Renowned for its vibrant ambiance and commitment to quality, the restaurant offers a wide array of traditional dishes including Butter Chicken, Garlic Naan, Prawn Madras, Malai Kofta, Dal Makhni, and Goat Curry, with many gluten-free options available. It prides itself on using fresh ingredients, exceptional service, and a welcoming environment that caters to both locals and tourists seeking a genuine taste of India. The business values culinary excellence, cultural heritage, and a supportive team culture where passion for food and hospitality drives a positive, collaborative workplace.
About the Position
The Chef plays a pivotal role in delivering high-quality Indian cuisine at Imperial Indian Restaurant. Reporting to management, this full-time position involves planning, organising, and overseeing the preparation and cooking of authentic dishes in a busy restaurant setting. The Chef ensures consistency in flavour, presentation, and food safety while contributing to menu development and kitchen efficiency, making them essential to maintaining the restaurant’s reputation for excellence and customer satisfaction.
Key Responsibilities
•	Planning menus, estimating food and labour costs, and ordering supplies to support efficient kitchen operations.
•	Preparing, seasoning, and cooking a variety of authentic Indian dishes, including curries, tandoori items, breads, and vegetarian options.
•	Monitoring the quality of dishes at all stages of preparation and presentation to uphold high standards.
•	Discussing food preparation issues with managers, kitchen staff, and waiting team to ensure smooth service.
•	Demonstrating cooking techniques and advising on procedures to support team development and consistency.
•	Maintaining cleanliness, hygiene, and food safety standards in line with regulatory requirements.
•	Managing kitchen inventory, minimising waste, and contributing to cost control measures.
Requirements
•	Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
•	Certificate III and IV in Kitchen Management, plus Diploma and Advanced Diploma in Hospitality Management.
•	Minimum 1 year of relevant experience.
•	Strong technical skills in Indian cuisine preparation, including mastery of spices, tandoor cooking, and regional dishes.
•	Excellent organisational and time-management abilities to handle a fast-paced kitchen environment.

Our client, Flyability SA, is looking for an Area Sales Manager to join the team. This role will be responsible for sales activities in a defined territory. The ASM will develop and maintain a sales pipeline, manage accounts, and manage channel distribution for our cutting edge technology in the defined territory. On a day-to-day basis, you will work closely with new customers to identify product fit and close deals. You will interface with our distribution partners in your area to ensure that opportunities are progressing and that they are receiving the support they need from us. You will also frequently meet with accounts in your territory to ensure their satisfaction and help them scale their use of the technology.

This role will own all commercial activities for the given territory, so we are looking for someone who can work independently and proactively, build and grow relationships with customers and partners, and who can quickly learn the needs of various industries to identify and deliver added value.

What you will own:

·Build and maintain leads and opportunities pipelines for direct and indirect sales
·Consult and follow up with prospects to solidify fit and value proposition and convert them to opportunities
·Source new sales opportunities through inbound lead follow-up; outbound campaigns and events
·Own the sales objectives and growth strategy in the territory
·Manage and develop a network of channel partners Walk opportunities through the buying process to help them acquire and deploy our technology by organizing presentations, demonstrations, and proof of concepts
·Coordinate and support sales activities for local distributors
·Build relationships with local key accounts with periodic discussions and ensure they scale to their full potential
·Build brand awareness and generate demand
·Build and execute business development activities in coordination with the marketing team
·Participate in developing and executing targeted nation-wide sales efforts
·Frequently meet with prospects and customers at their locations or during roadshows and tradeshows
·Travel to industrial sites for meetings, demonstrations, or proof of concepts.
·Work on industrial sites may include operating the drone in-asset, which could imply working at heights or in hazardous environments
·Assist in organizing and executing multiple tradeshows and roadshows nation-wide
·Assist with various sales projects as needed

Quali cations and Experience:

Bachelor of Business Economics or similar
At least 6 years experience in a similar role Experience with B2B, B2C Business Development Experience in Regional Sales Management Critical thinking and Problem solving
